experiment: P3b hierarchical ISRJ width-band and local-regression expert
research_question: Can a hierarchical width-band gate remove the rare cross-band errors that caused P3a ACF ordinal failure while preserving within-band ordering?

data.classification_loss: interference classification disabled; only parameter width-band supervision is used

features.input: P3a complex ACF real and magnitude residual sequences plus lag position
features.reason: both caused 3-of-3 negative transfer in frozen P3a

variants.B0_flat_acf_ordinal: P3a flat cumulative ordinal head retrained on seed200
variants.B1_hierarchical: five-band classifier plus five band-conditional local sigmoid regression heads

training.decode: hard argmax band followed by selected local head

stop_rule: Do not tune bands, loss weights or architecture on seed250. If B1 fails, stop learned ISRJ-width development and retain only the P2x oracle sufficiency result.
